text:
AN336
Culture, Power and Politics
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
introduces
students
to the major contemporary approaches to the study of politics and power in anthropology. Topics to be addressed include the state, civil society, citizenship, ethnicity, race and nationalism, sovereignty and violence.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
